yt_title: Sorty works the door of your to-do list
caption:
You're not on the list. 🚫

I made Sorty the bouncer for my saved reels:
"100 AI agents at once": not tonight
"Comment SCALE": no tip, no entry
"AI receptionist for local businesses": you're in

Download your Instagram data (Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Some of your information → Saved → HTML), then drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Sort yours free, link in bio.
